_comment: Tier-2: SmallStrainJ2PlasticityPlaneStrain2DLaw reports GetStrainSize()==4 and is therefore silently incompatible with the 2D solid elements, which build a 3-component B-matrix. Pitfall (kratos.constitutive_laws #2). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv). The law instantiates and IS registered — nothing rejects it, which is why the pitfall calls the failure silent. Measured strain sizes: J2 plane-strain law 4; SmallStrainIsotropicPlasticityPlaneStrainVonMisesVonMises 3; LinearElasticPlaneStrain2DLaw 3; LinearElasticPlaneStress2DLaw 3. The size mismatch is the only available signal. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics for real; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
